intro: Lesson 21: 3.1 The Shahadah: nature, role and use in Muslim life (Qur'an 3:18-19). To understand the nature and importance of the Shahadah and how it is used in Muslim life

picture.alt: A minaret: the adhan contains the Shahadah
picture.draw: Draw and label: Pupil PDF worksheet: Shahadah in life diagram

questions.q: Explain what 3:18-19 teaches about the Shahadah. (4 marks, our own question)
questions.a: Allah Himself, the angels and people of knowledge bear witness there is no god but Him, so Muslims join this witness; and the true religion with Allah is Islam.
questions.model: Point 1: the Shahadah is the greatest witness. Develop: Allah, the angels and the people of knowledge testify to His oneness (3:18). Point 2: it marks the true religion. Develop: 'the religion in the sight of Allah is Islam' (3:19), so saying it enters a person into Islam.

questions.q: The second half of the Shahadah is about ...
In the portal response box: 'Describe how the Shahadah is used in a Muslim's life from birth to death.' Use at least four uses. Start: 'From the moment a Muslim is born, ...'
questions.a: Adhan at birth, salah and tashahhud, adhan, conversion, daily choices, last words hoped at death
questions.model: Teacher writes: 'From the moment a Muslim is born, many families say the adhan, which contains the Shahadah, in the baby's ear.'

questions.q: why must the Shahadah be said with knowledge and sincerity?
questions.a: Words alone are not enough; it must be believed and acted on (the hypocrites said it without belief).

questions.q: what does Tawhid in the Shahadah rule out?
questions.a: Shirk: worshipping or calling on anything besides Allah.

questions.q: Back to our ponder: why can a few words change a life?
questions.a: The Shahadah commits a person to Tawhid and following the Prophet ﷺ in everything.
